title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.19 - a round of attribution fixes, all from player reports. Damage that a drawn card sets off is now credited to the effect that dealt it rather than to the potion that did the drawing: with Speedster up, a Cure All, Clarity, Swift Potion, Glowwater Potion, Bottled Potential or Snecko Oil used to take the credit for it. Eight effects that dealt their damage anonymously now name themselves - Sleight of Flesh, Juggernaut, Necro Mastery, Smokestack, Thunder, Parrying Shield, Screaming Flagon and Stone Calendar all read as "(none)" before. And in co-op, the block Beacon of Hope gives away is credited to the player who gave it instead of the one wearing it. On the display side, the paging arrows and the fight picker's caret are drawn rather than typed, so they no longer come out as boxes with a hex code in them on Linux installs whose font was missing those characters. Checked against game v0.109.1.
